data.description: Reproduce: in a fresh worktree with no .tickets-tracker, run pytest tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_plan_review_gate.py::test_review_plan_help_states_that_pass_signs_by_default — the test passes but the conftest leak check errors: a symlink .tickets-tracker -> <main checkout>/.tickets-tracker is created in the worktree root as a side effect of rendering CLI help (no REBAR_ROOT monkeypatch in that test, so repo_root resolves to the real worktree). Pre-existing on main (reproduced at f9fe49b06 with a clean tree); masked everywhere the symlink already exists. Expected: rendering --help must not write to the repo root; the test should also isolate REBAR_ROOT. Acceptance criteria: (1) running the help test in a fresh worktree with no .tickets-tracker passes with no leak-check error and creates no symlink; (2) identify and pin the code path that bootstraps the tracker symlink on a read-only/help path with a regression test; (3) make lint, make typecheck, and the default suite exit zero.
data.title: review-plan --help leaks a .tickets-tracker symlink into a fresh worktree's repo root during tests
